analyst_view.overall: ADO Den Haag sacked coach Robin Peter this week, and assistant Levi Schwiebbe takes charge for this one. Maurice Steijn is reported as the likely successor but was not confirmed as of Friday. ADO are 17th and have lost three in a row. Sparta, near the drop zone, won 3-2 at Groningen and are expected to set up with a back five. Toornstra went off early at Groningen and one report lists him only as a doubt.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Sparta's expected back five and the caution of a relegation six-pointer, with a stand-in coach on ADO's bench, point to a tighter game than the attacking ratings suggest. We lean slightly lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners. Nothing in the news moves it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. It's a South Holland derby with relegation at stake and a caretaker coach for ADO, so we lean higher.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.0 shots. ADO at home should push, but Sparta's back five will limit space, so we stay with the numbers.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target. A packed Sparta defence and two struggling attacks suggest fewer clean chances, so we lean a little lower.
